title: Bank of England MPC decision + April Monetary Policy Report — the forecast round whose conditioning window closes before the Fed decides, on a VAT step it has no data on (12:00 London / 07:00 ET)
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200) — the 2027 panel is headed 'Provisional dates' and lists 'Thursday 4 February', 'Thursday 18 March', 'Thursday 29 April', 'Thursday 17 June', 'Thursday 29 July', 'Thursday 16 September', 'Thursday 4 November', 'Thursday 16 December', with Monetary Policy Reports on February, April, July and November — so 29 April is an MPR round. UPGRADED THIS SESSION FROM A SECOND BoE PRIMARY THE PROPOSAL DID NOT HAVE: bankofengland.co.uk/news/2025/december/mpc-dates-for-2027, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200), is the Bank's own announcement of these dates, 'Published on 18 December 2025', headed 'Provisional dates for Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) announcements on Bank Rate and publication of MPC meeting minutes and the quarterly Monetary Policy Report' — the same eight dates and the same four MPR months, from a second independent BoE surface. notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THE never-assessed INITIAL RESEARCH 2026-09-09, superseding proposals/boe-decision-2027-04-29.from-uk-electricity-vat-reversion-2027-04-01.json (read in full first per docs/process/EVENT-RESEARCH.md). THE PROPOSAL'S SEQUENCING FINDING IS VERIFIED AND KEPT, now against fetched ONS primaries rather than assertion: MPC 2027-03-18 (no MPR, pre-lapse) -> the electricity-VAT reversion 2027-04-01 -> UK CPI for MARCH data on 2027-04-21 (ONS release page fetched direct 2026-09-09, 'Provisional release date: 21 April 2027 7:00am', 'This release is not yet published' — still a zero-rated collection month) -> THIS MEETING, publishing an MPR that must book the step with no post-reversion observation -> UK CPI for APRIL data on 2027-05-19 (ONS, fetched, 'not yet published' — the first observation) -> MPC 2027-06-17, the first committee to see it. Forecast to first-committee is 49 days, exactly the seven weeks the proposal claimed. TWO IMPACT-BEARING CORRECTIONS THIS SESSION MADE TO THE PROPOSAL. (1) TIER RAISED low -> medium. The proposal tiered it low on a 'symbols: [] and no UK instrument' argument that applies IDENTICALLY to boe-decision-2026-09-17, -2026-11-05 and -2026-12-17, all tiered medium, and to boj-decision-2027-04-28, also medium. Tiering the same class of event two ways would make the cadence incoherent without making the book any safer; the no-instrument fact belongs in the CALL (it is a stand-aside at high confidence) rather than in the tier. (2) THE MPR CONDITIONING WINDOW IS THE FINDING THE PROPOSAL DID NOT HAVE, AND IT IS THE ONE GENERALISABLE MECHANIC HERE. An MPR's projections are conditioned on the market rate path averaged over the 15 working days to a stated cut-off, and the cut-off runs 8-10 days BEFORE publication — measured from two BoE primaries fetched 2026-09-09: the April 2026 MPR, 'Published on 30 April 2026', conditioned on 'the 15 days to 22 April' (8 days), and the July 2026 MPR, 'Published on 30 July 2026', conditioned on 'the 15 working days to 20 July' (10 days). Applied to 2027-04-29 that puts the cut-off at roughly 2027-04-19 to 2027-04-21. Two consequences the family had not written down. It falls ON OR WITHIN TWO DAYS OF the March 2027 CPI print (2027-04-21) — and on the exact April analogue it fell ON the print date, since the March 2026 CPI bulletin was released 22 April 2026, the very cut-off the April 2026 MPR names. And it falls SEVEN TO TEN DAYS BEFORE fomc-2027-04-28, so the published April 2027 forecast is conditioned on a curve struck BEFORE the Fed decides; reading those projections against the post-Fed curve compares two different worlds. (3) NO PRICING EXISTS FOR THIS MEETING. centralbank.watch's Bank of England page, fetched direct 2026-09-09, publishes rows only through 2026-12-17; there are no 2027 rows. The decomposition method that produced the entire contribution of the boe-decision-2026-12-17 ledger DOES NOT REACH HERE, and this ledger registers no rate-direction test rather than manufacturing one. (4) ATTRIBUTION INVERTS THE DECEMBER RULE. Seven tracked events sit within five days: boj-decision-2027-04-28 and fomc-2027-04-28 (high) the DAY BEFORE, consumer-confidence-2027-04-27, fhfa-hpi-2027-04-27, russell-style-month-end-capping-effective-2027-04-30, tic-annual-survey-final-2027-04-30, treasury-borrowing-estimates-2027-05-03. The BoE is the LAST of three central banks in about 36 hours and — per fomc-2027-04-28's own header, whose Fed calendar row carries no SEP asterisk — the ONLY ONE OF THE THREE PUBLISHING A FULL FORECAST ROUND. The December ledger's rule ('a projection round outranks a set of minutes') therefore ranks the BoE ABOVE the Fed for INTERPRETIVE CONTENT on this cluster, and that is the only sense in which it does: for market impact on eight US mega-caps the Fed still outranks it and nothing here changes that. WHAT IS PROPOSED IN THIS PR: uk-cpi-2027-04-21 (the conditioning-cut-off print, unproposed by anyone) and boe-decision-2027-06-17 (the venue where the look-through question actually resolves). The April 2027 UK labour-market date is NOT proposed — gov.uk statistics announcements, fetched 2026-09-09, returns no 2027 labour-market overview at all; a negative result stated, never filled in. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: symbols: [], and no house playbook is rates- or sterling-keyed. Estimate widens caution only, and here the label is load-bearing rather than cosmetic — the Bank's own 2027 dates are provisional and must be re-checked against its published calendar before anything is keyed to them.
